caption: Recorded instructor comparison: one validated parent; control and both variations each receive 3000 extra steps. Only action-change penalty (1 to 3) or swing target (6 to 7.5 cm) changes. Baseline and both variations pass the full 50-trial command suite. The control fails fast-walking drift despite zero falls. Smoother reduces forward action-change RMS by about 16%; the higher target does not increase measured swing. One training seed; five perturbed evaluation starts.
